summary:
Programme's public [fault-population decision](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4517#issuecomment-6194624599) and [phase/loss matrix](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4517#issuecomment-6194859259) define a no-effect contract for a later reviewed source/runtime proposal. Authentication-child/process loss and whole protected job/runner/VM loss are included; wider loss is not excluded or waived. When required independent evidence is absent, retain last-known issuance, token-slot and acknowledged-phase facts, report Unknown/unqualified/incomplete cleanup, and never retry. Do not infer non-issuance from disappearance, expiry or missing output.
A surviving-job custodian may make only the single originally admitted same-token cleanup attempt after its required durable phase ACK, ending by the original 285-second work cutoff. Issuance-possible or a lost issuance response never authorizes a second token. Revocation-possible or a lost response never authorizes another DELETE. Only the original independently observed exact-token HTTP 204 plus durable phase ACK settles revocation; GET, expiry or another DELETE cannot substitute. Preserve previously durable verified revocation and terminal facts after wider loss. Qualification remains false/Unknown unless every original terminal, identity, task, reporting and ACK predicate had already been satisfied.
Every phase preserves the original operation descriptor, source/candidate/dependency pins, first failure and normal 270-second, work 285-second and total 300-second cutoffs. Total time settles supervision/outstanding work; it is not extra credential-effect time. Bootstrap, child or job restart cannot refresh the clock. A job status, artifact, log or agent message is not a phase ACK. Stronger independently held original admissions must be reconciled before effects.
Programme/domain authority owns the operation/capability and matrix; the App JWT signer is a distinct issuer. SystemAdmin owns the proposed source-pinned supervisor/ingress and independently durable nonsecret ACK/loss-observation route outside the job/VM, consistent with CI-owned credential execution rather than a host wallet or per-run host-agent relay. Store/observer/issuer/runtime/executable/transport selection and qualification remain pending; generic SSH, journal credentials and job artifacts supply no substitute.
Accepted inert factory/managed source and the protected false job remain unavailable for native construction. The provider's old publisher-path binding still needs a separately reviewed closed contract/source-bundle/vector revision. Retain the cooperative HTTP deadline failure: current source does not establish hard cleanup completion. All six native selections and effect flags remain held. Original .103 attempted-unknown tag dispatch, nine dependency pins and .104 release hold remain unchanged; authentication does not settle or replay the historical effect.
title: Original authentication loss matrix preserves Unknown outcomes and original custody bounds
